A_target.statement:
Let $a_1, \ldots, a_n \in \R$.
Then:
:$\displaystyle \frac 1 n \sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n a_i \le \sqrt {\frac 1 n \sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n a_i^2}$

B_source.statement:
Let $u_i, v_i \in \R$.
Then:
:$\displaystyle \paren {\sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n u_i v_i}^2 \le \paren {\sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n u_i^2} \paren {\sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n v_i^2}$

validity_conditions: Setting v_i = 1 for all i gives sum v_i^2 = n and sum u_i v_i = sum a_i.
Dividing by n^2 and taking square roots yields RMS-AM.
proof_plan: Apply the [[Cauchy-Bunyakovsky-Schwarz Inequality]] with $u_i = a_i$ and $v_i = 1$.

Dividing by $n^2$:
:$\displaystyle \paren {\frac 1 n \sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n a_i}^2 \le \frac 1 n \sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n a_i^2$
